target.title: fix(channels): drop reasoning deltas that are a sub-string of the current buffer
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`mergeReasoningProgressText` (shared `src/channels/progress-draft-compositor.ts`) only guarded the case where the incoming delta is an extension of the current buffer (`normalizedIncoming.startsWith(normalizedCurrent)`). It missed the reverse: when incoming is a sub-string of current (a partial resend after a network hiccup or reconnect), the delta fell through to the append branch and concatenated already-seen text — e.g. `current='Reading files'` + `incoming='Read'` produced `Reading filesRead` in the visible progress draft. The Slack sibling merger `mergeSlackReasoningProgressText` (`extensions/slack/.../dispatch.ts`) had the same gap.

## Why This Change Was Made

Add the symmetric check: when `normalizedCurrent` already starts with `normalizedIncoming`, keep the longer current buffer and wait for the next delta instead of duplicating the prefix. Applied to both the shared compositor (commit 1) and the Slack sibling merger (commit 2) so Slack and other channels render identically.

## User Impact

A reasoning stream that partially resends a prefix after a reconnect no longer duplicates that prefix in the visible Slack / channel progress draft. The draft keeps the longer buffer (`Reading files`) until the real next delta arrives. Extension and snapshot cases are unchanged.

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior addressed:** A reasoning delta that was a sub-string of the current buffer (partial resend) duplicated the prefix into the visible progress draft (`Reading files` + `Read` -> `Reading filesRead`).
- **Real environment tested:** Linux x86_64, Node v24.14.0, commit `0efa45e4da` on branch `fix/channels-reasoning-substring-dedup` (current head, after the Slack sibling application).
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch:** `node --import tsx verify-reasoning-substring.mjs` — imports the real `createChannelProgressDraftCompositor` from `src/channels/progress-draft-compositor.ts`, drives the real reasoning progress path (`pushReasoningProgress`) with `Reading files` then `Read` (substring resend), and renders the draft with a Slack-style reasoning prefix. The Slack sibling path is covered by `dispatch.preview-fallback.test.ts` which drives the real `dispatchPreparedSlackMessage` and asserts the Slack draft never contains `Reading filesRead`.
- **Evidence after fix:** Terminal capture of `node` runtime verification (live stdout, copied verbatim):

  ```text
  $ node --import tsx verify-reasoning-substring.mjs
  reasoning stream sent: 'Reading files' then 'Read' (substring resend)
  final rendered progress draft:
    | Shelling
    |
    | 🛠️ Exec
    | • • _Reading files_

  contains duplicated 'Reading filesRead'? NO (guard kept the longer buffer)
  keeps the longer 'Reading files'?      YES

  Verdict: the substring-resend guard keeps '• Reading files' instead of duplicating 'Reading filesRead'.
  ```

- **Observed result after fix:** Sending `Reading files` followed by the substring `Read` keeps the longer `Reading files` in the rendered draft; the duplicated `Reading filesRead` no longer appears. The Slack sibling merger applies the identical guard (its dedicated test on this PR head sends the same `Reading files` -> `Read` sequence through the real `dispatchPreparedSlackMessage` and asserts the Slack draft is `Shelling\n• Reading files` with no `Reading filesRead`).
- **What was not tested:** A live Slack desktop rendering of the draft (the `dispatch.preview-fallback.test.ts` case drives the real Slack dispatch path with a stubbed Slack client; a maintainer can optionally request a `@openclaw-mantis` Slack desktop smoke using the suggested command if a rendered screenshot is required).

## Tests and validation

```text
$ pnpm test src/channels/progress-draft-compositor.test.ts
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  14 passed (14)

$ pnpm test extensions/slack/src/monitor/message-handler/dispatch.preview-fallback.test.ts
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  81 passed (81)

$ pnpm tsgo:core:test
EXIT=0 (type check passed)
```

Added `ignores reasoning deltas that are a substring of the current buffer` to both the shared compositor suite and the Slack `dispatch.preview-fallback` suite (the latter drives the real `dispatchPreparedSlackMessage` and asserts the Slack-visible draft keeps `Reading files` with no `Reading filesRead`).

## Risk checklist

- User-visible behavior: Yes (intended, bounded) - a substring resend no longer duplicates the prefix in the Slack / channel progress draft; extension and snapshot cases unchanged.
- Config/env/migration behavior: No - no config or env surface touched.
- Security/auth/secrets/network/tool execution: No - purely a progress-draft merge predicate.
- Plugins/providers/channels/SDK: Yes (bounded) - touches the shared `mergeReasoningProgressText` (affects every channel using the compositor) and the Slack sibling `mergeSlackReasoningProgressText`; both are file-local merge helpers with no public API change.
- Highest-risk area: a channel whose reasoning stream legitimately resends a shorter prefix and expected the old append behavior - but the old behavior was a duplication bug; the new predicate only keeps the longer buffer and waits for the next delta.
- Mitigation: 14 compositor + 81 Slack dispatch tests (incl. the two new substring-resend cases) + node runtime verification on the current head.

Closes: N/A (no existing issue)
